mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, content, enabled, status, version_no AS versionNo, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM skill ORDER BY name
SELECT id, name, description, content, enabled, status, version_no AS versionNo, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM skill WHERE name = #{name}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill (name, description, content, enabled, status, version_no) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{content}, #{enabled}, #{status}, #{versionNo})
mapper.update: UPDATE skill SET description = #{description}, content = #{content}, enabled = #{enabled}, status = #{status}, version_no = #{versionNo} WHERE name = #{name}
